name: rejected-hypothesis
description: A suspected cause (DNS) is investigated and ruled out; the real cause (MTU) is found and fixed. Memory must record the real cause, never the rejected one as fact.

turns.text: Pulls from the registry over the VPN hang at random. I bet it's DNS.
Checked: dig against the VPN resolver answers in 3ms every time and the hangs happen after the TCP connection is up, so DNS is ruled out.
tcpdump on wg0 shows large TLS records never acknowledged: the path MTU is below the 1420 wg0 default and ICMP fragmentation-needed is filtered upstream.
Set wg0 MTU to 1380 in /etc/wireguard/wg0.conf and restarted the tunnel. 20 consecutive registry pulls succeeded. Fixed and verified.
